title: Paloma Business Deposit-Relationship Credit Bands
content:
Deposits decide a deposit-relationship credit on the subscription charge of a monthly-billed Paloma Business account for a billing period: the deposits the business made to its balance in the three months before the day the charge is worked out, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day. Deposits by every method credited to the balance in that window are added together.

### Bands

| Deposits in the three-month window | Deposit-relationship credit |
|---|---|
| 60000.00 USD or more | 20.00 USD |
| 30000.00 USD up to 59999.99 USD | 8.00 USD |
| Below 30000.00 USD | None |

As a clause: deposits totalling 60000.00 USD or more earn a deposit-relationship credit of 20.00 USD; deposits totalling 30000.00 USD up to 59999.99 USD earn 8.00 USD; smaller totals earn no deposit-relationship credit.

The credit is a fixed amount in US dollars deducted from the period's subscription charge. Every fixed amount the charge carries, deducted or added, acts at the same point, on the monthly fee as billed for the period after any percentage discount on that fee: the charge is that fee less every fixed amount deducted plus every fixed amount added, and only that result is held at no less than 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical totals)

| Window total | Credit |
|---|---|
| 60000.00 USD | 20.00 USD |
| 59999.99 USD | 8.00 USD |
| 30000.00 USD | 8.00 USD |
| 29999.99 USD | None |

### Window example (hypothetical dates)

A charge worked out on 10 July counts the deposits received from 11 April through 10 July. Deposits of 25000.00 USD on 2 May, 20000.00 USD on 1 June and 18000.00 USD on 9 July total 63000.00 USD and earn 20.00 USD; a further deposit on 10 April falls outside the window.

A hypothetical figure for the floor: a monthly fee as billed of 10.00 USD after any percentage discount, this credit of 20.00 USD and a fixed amount of 15.00 USD added to the same charge give 10.00 less 20.00 plus 15.00, that is 5.00 USD; with no amount added the result would be below zero and the charge is 0.00 USD.
